messages:
Maya CSM: Quick heads-up — wrapping LumaHealth onboarding. Need to lock the customer-facing comms for uptime/latency targets and the credits calc before the renewal readout next Wed.
Raj Ops: Got it. Current internal SLOs we use for them: uptime 99.9% (monthly), p95 latency < 180ms on /v1/generate-text route. I'll share the dashboard links in a sec.
Kim Support: I can pull the acceptance test artifacts and warmup logs. Do we want the raw traces or a condensed evidence bundle?
Maya CSM: Condensed bundle please (summary + failures). Also include the synthetic soak test that shows steady-state p95. Ellie needs something that non-technical procurement can read.
Ellie (LumaHealth): Thx. Procurement cares about how credits are calculated. Can you share an example calculation we can include in the SLA appendix?
Raj Ops: Example (rough): `credit = max(0, (target_uptime - measured_uptime) / target_uptime) * monthly_fee` — we usually cap to X% and have a minimum incident threshold. I'll attach the real calc with caps.
Maya CSM: Perfect. Also, enablement ask: schedule a 30m handoff for product+support to run through observability and incident playbooks. Suggested time Tue 10am PT.
Kim Support: I can run the playbook demo. I'll add the testing checklist to the bundle: `smoke.sh`, synthetic timeseries screenshots, and a short note on warmup recommendations (prefix-caching).
enablement-bot: Reminder created: "LumaHealth enablement handoff" Tue 10:00 PT — invite sent to Maya, Raj, Kim, Ellie. :calendar:
Raj Ops: One more: for the renewal deck, we want a one-slide summary — measured uptime last 30 days, p95 latency, any credit that would have been owed, and recommended mitigations.
Ellie (LumaHealth): That one-slide is perfect. Can you also include a plain-English note on why p95 matters vs p99? Procurement asked.
Maya CSM: Will include a 2-bullet note. Kim — can you target EOD tomorrow for the evidence bundle? Raj — dashboard snapshot by morning?
Kim Support: EOD tomorrow works. I'll put download links in the bundle and a short README.
Raj Ops: Dashboard snapshots posted: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/lumahealth/sla-summary (use internal link until we sanitise for customer). Will export public-friendly PNGs for the deck.
Maya CSM: Great — after bundle + slide are ready I'll loop in Sales for the renewal run-through. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-15T09:12:42Z finished — no incidents.
